weeks.topic: Brief History of Prophet Musa (AS) The bad king: Fir'awn (Pharaoh)
weeks.content:
Who was Prophet Musa (Moses)?
Pharaoh was mean to the people
Baby Musa is born
Pharaoh wanted to kill baby boys
Musa's mother puts him in a basket
The basket floats on the river
Allah protects baby Musa
Pharaoh's wife finds the basket
She wants to keep baby Musa
Baby Musa goes back to his mother
- Allah's wonderful plan

weeks.topic: Brief History of Prophet Musa (AS) Musa leaves Egypt and goes to Madyan
weeks.content:
Musa grows up in the palace
Musa helps two girls at a well
Musa becomes a shepherd
Allah speaks to Musa from a burning bush
Allah tells Musa: "Go to Pharaoh"
Musa gets help from his brother Harun
Musa's special miracles: Staff turns into snake,
shining hand
Musa goes to Pharaoh: "Let my people go"
Pharaoh says "No!"
The contest with magicians
- Magicians believe in Allah
Assessment of Topics covered in Weeks 1-4

weeks.topic: Brief History of Prophet Musa (AS) Pharaoh chases them with his army
weeks.content:
Musa leads people out of Egypt
They reach the Red Sea
People are scared
Musa says: "Allah will help us"
The sea splits into two!
People walk through safely
Pharaoh tries to follow
The sea closes and Pharaoh drowns
Allah saves Musa and the people
- Lessons: Trust Allah, be brave, Allah helps
good people

weeks.topic: Brief History of Prophet Isa (AS) Maryam (Mary): A very good woman
weeks.content:
Who was Prophet Isa (Jesus)?
Maryam loved to pray
Angel Jibreel visits Maryam
Allah gives Maryam a baby (miracle - no
father)
Baby Isa is born
Allah sends dates and water for Maryam
People ask questions
Baby Isa speaks from the cradle!
Baby Isa says: "I am Allah's servant"
Everyone is amazed
- Lesson: Allah can do anything

weeks.topic: Brief History of Prophet Isa (AS) Isa loves his mother Maryam
weeks.content:
Isa grows up as a good boy
Isa becomes a Prophet
Isa's message: Worship only Allah
Isa's miracles (with Allah's permission):
o Making clay birds come alive
o Healing sick people
o Helping blind people see
Many people believe in Isa
Some people didn't like Isa
Allah protects Prophet Isa
- Lessons: Be kind, help others, listen to
Prophets
